title: 帕斯弗洛爾 FPSO 開發
summary: 帕斯弗洛爾是 Block 17 的浮式中心；課程以海底與船上功能分界，分析分離、輸送和驗證資料。本課依序分析海底與甲板分離邊界、分段輸液功率、沿程壓降與未含項、難接近設備修復時間、跨界面量測同步，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Pazflor is a Block 17 floating hub; this case studies boundaries between subsea and onboard separation and transfer functions. The course analyses subsea-versus-deck separation boundary, pumping work by segment, friction loss and omitted effects, repair time for inaccessible equipment, meter synchronization across interfaces, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 海底與甲板分離邊界、分段輸液功率、沿程壓降與未含項
v31FocusEn: Subsea-versus-deck separation boundary; Pumping work by segment; Friction loss and omitted effects

quiz.question: 關於「海底與甲板分離邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Subsea-versus-deck separation boundary" is correct?
options: 停留時間是有效液體容積除以流率；容積不能直接使用設備外形體積，因為氣相空間、內件與不可用區域會縮小液體庫存。
停留時間足夠長就保證所有乳化油水完全分離。
只要泵出口壓力高，就代表輸液效率高。
optionsEn: Residence time is effective liquid inventory divided by flow.
A long residence time guarantees complete separation of every emulsion.
A high discharge pressure proves high pumping efficiency.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Subsea-versus-deck separation boundary” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Pazflor FPSO development”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「海底與甲板分離邊界」。帕斯弗洛爾是 Block 17 的浮式中心；課程以海底與船上功能分界，分析分離、輸送和驗證資料。在「帕斯弗洛爾 FPSO 開發」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。停留時間是有效液體容積除以流率；容積不能直接使用設備外形體積，因為氣相空間、內件與不可用區域會縮小液體庫存。停留時間只是一項篩選指標，粒徑、乳化、密度差與流場短路仍會控制真正分離效果。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Subsea-versus-deck separation boundary”. Pazflor is a Block 17 floating hub; this case studies boundaries between subsea and onboard separation and transfer functions. In the teaching model for Pazflor FPSO development, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. Residence time is effective liquid inventory divided by flow. The outer vessel volume is inappropriate because gas space, internals and inactive regions reduce usable inventory. Residence time is only a screening metric; droplet size, emulsions, density contrast and hydraulic short-circuiting still govern real separation performance. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 海底與甲板分離邊界：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Subsea-versus-deck separation boundary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = V/Q；代入 V = 54 m³、Q = 300 m³/h，得 10.8 min（「海底與甲板分離邊界」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Q 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = V/Q; with V = 54 m³, Q = 300 m³/h the result is 10.8 min (simplified exercise for Subsea-versus-deck separation boundary; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Q by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 10.8 min（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Q 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 10.8 min (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Q with an engineering explanation.

steps.titleEn: Subsea-versus-deck separation boundary: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「海底與甲板分離邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。

steps.instruction: 針對「海底與甲板分離邊界」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。用教學槽的有效容積與出入口流率計算平均停留時間，再比較示蹤曲線的前緣與平均值，判斷是否出現旁通與死區。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Subsea-versus-deck separation boundary”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Calculate mean residence time from effective inventory and inlet/outlet flow, then compare tracer-curve arrival and mean time to identify bypassing and inactive regions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 029-01 標記，圖表須寫明「帕斯弗洛爾 FPSO 開發：教學假設」。提交容積定義、流率基準及示蹤曲線解釋，將分離效率與停留時間分成兩個驗收量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 029-01 and mark charts “Pazflor FPSO development: teaching assumptions”. Document the inventory definition, flow basis and tracer interpretation, treating separation efficiency and residence time as separate acceptance quantities.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「海底與甲板分離邊界」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Subsea-versus-deck separation boundary” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A high discharge pressure proves high pumping efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 「分段輸液功率」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。低估摩擦損失會低估電耗；混用表壓與絕壓、把百分比效率直接代入，或忽略回流支路都可能造成看似違反能量守恆的結果。
knowledge.textEn: An error at “Pumping work by segment” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Underestimated friction losses understate energy demand; mixed gauge/absolute readings, percentage efficiency entered directly, or ignored recycle flows can make the balance appear to violate conservation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
